entries.004708df5668d42e: The management policy states that it has responded from system development to data output using high-speed kanji printers and mailing services, centered on integrated production of computer forms from planning, design, manufacturing and delivery; that it recognizes the protection and management of personal information as extremely important for data output work, a priority measure; and that it has obtained Privacy Mark, ISO9001 and ISO14001 certifications. The analysis of results of operations and the like also states that security structures have been strengthened through the establishment of a CSIRT and the formulation of a basic information security policy.
entries.02041b3721dd1097: This business manufactures and sells printed matter such as continuous forms, sheet forms, specialty paper, uniform slips, envelopes and brochures. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥2,462 million.

entries.226706866e56af72: Its management policy sets out a “customer-centric” principle, and it develops its business centered on integrated production of computer forms, from planning, design and manufacturing through to delivery. Under its medium- to long-term strategy, it will work to further improve efficiency in “Printing-related” and “DPP,” where paperless practices are advancing, while developing “WEB” and “BPO” as priority fields aligned with customers’ DX initiatives. Regarding its production structure, it is carrying out a fundamental review, gradually dispersing the functions of the Takao Plant to other sites, and after repairing and renovating the building of the former Takao Plant, developing it as a base equipped with new functions. The medium-term management plan announced in February 2024 also sets out, as its first priority, “business expansion in priority fields through new product categories.”
